reviews.body: It's difficult to review this without any tests - but I've found a few potential race conditions.

Could you please provide more details on how you will achieve the requirements for L4? The document is currently very high level and missing important information about how authentication, authorization, resource limits, and process execution will work.

I think most of my comments have been addressed. It'd be nice to have a little more detail on how the log streaming will work - this is probably one of the trickiest elements of the task, so diving deeper into its design at this state is warranted.
